'''August 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (11 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 11 August 2001. [[Bill Prather]] won it. It is known from Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2848">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 16 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Bill Prather]]
